messages:
deploy-bot: :rocket: Starting staging deploy
deploy-bot: env=staging, tag=v2.13.0-stg, runbook=https://wiki.redwood.com/staging-deploys/v2.13.0, expected_duration=10m
deploy-bot: commits: api=6a1f3c2 -> 7b2e4d1, orchestrator=4c8b11a -> 5d9f7e2, frontend=fa3b2c0 -> fb7e9d4
emma_rm: Ack. Pin request for canary: 10% for 5m then 50% for 10m. I'll be watching metrics. @dinesh_sre please keep an eye on latency dashboards.
alice_chan: Noted, smoke tests queued. I'll post results within 6m.
carla_qc: Running quick reranker + integration smoke. Focus on token-level latency and reranker accuracy on the new model path.
dinesh_sre: Watching infra. Pre-deploy checks green. I pre-warmed pods and KV cache.
bob_eng: FYI the database migration is a noop for this tag, so no downtime expected.
deploy-bot: canary traffic shift to 10% initiated -> 2023-09-15T14:02:23Z
alice_chan: smoke: PASS for api and orchestrator, frontend minor styling flicker (non-blocking).
carla_qc: reranker latency spike observed at +2m for batch 3: 180ms -> 680ms, comparing to baseline. Investigating prompt path.
emma_rm: @carla_qc good catch. Hold canary at 10% while we triage. Do not escalate traffic.
dinesh_sre: Pausing further traffic shift via canary controller: `kubectl patch canary staging-v2 --patch '{"spec":{"pause":true}}'`
bob_eng: I see an unexpected quantization fallback on orchestrator causing CPU spin. Rolling back orchestrator binary to previous build might fix.
alice_chan: Reproduced locally with `--seq-len 1024` on the new image, latency regression only when cache miss.
emma_rm: Decision: abort further rollout, pin orchestrator to commit 4c8b11a (previous stable) and continue api/frontend. Can someone run the pin flow?
dinesh_sre: Starting pin workflow. `deploy-bot rollback orchestrator --to 4c8b11a --env staging`
deploy-bot: orchestrator rollback started -> target=4c8b11a
alice_chan: smoke after rollback: orchestrator latency back to baseline (avg 95ms). Reranker no longer spiking.
carla_qc: reranker accuracy unchanged after orchestrator pin. Good.
emma_rm: OK, we'll proceed with partial rollforward: api/frontend remain at v2.13.0-stg, orchestrator pinned. Keep canary at 10% for another 8m then reassess.
deploy-bot: staging deploy completed (partial): api=7b2e4d1 deployed, frontend=fb7e9d4 deployed, orchestrator=pinned->4c8b11a. duration=12m. notes=https://wiki.redwood.com/staging-deploys/v2.13.0/postmortem
dinesh_sre: Added incident tag `stg-deploy-partial-pin` and created a task to re-evaluate quantization kernel selector in the optimizer backlog.
emma_rm: Thanks team — follow-ups: open PR to adjust kernel selector + add the cache-miss perf test. I'll schedule a small retro. :thumbsup:
carla_qc: marking tests passed in release checklist.
bob_eng: putting a patch in to avoid the fallback path; will link PR in the follow-up ticket.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Deploy run closed. Summary attached to thread.
